visualCharacteristics.purpose: product / extension tiles in a 4-column grid: logo, name, vendor, star rating, partner badge, price

contentPattern.structure: one row per product; cells (any may be omitted, recognised by content): logo image, product name (heading or link to the product), vendor, rating (number 0-5, e.g. 4.5), partner badge (text containing "Partner", e.g. Gold Technology Partner), price (e.g. $99.00 or $75.00 / year)

usage: Partner profile pages: the partner's extensions list.
reuseGuidance: Use for any product grid authored as content. Product data from the commerce catalog belongs in product-list-page instead.
